name: Zhuzhou Huarui Precision Cutting Tools Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhuzhou Huarui Precision Cutting Tools Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of cemented carbide inserts in China and internationally. The company offers turning and milling inserts; threading inserts; carbide inserts for aluminium; parting and grooving inserts; drilling inserts; solid carbide end mills; and cermet inserts. Its products are used in aerospace, rail traffic, automobile, general machinery, and engineering machinery industries. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Zhuzhou, China.
